ائتنسا (form VIII)
# اِئْتَنَسَا (iʔtanasā) /iʔ.ta.na.saː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِئْتَنَسَ (iʔtanasa)
# اِئْتَنِسَا (iʔtanisā) /iʔ.ta.ni.saː/: second-person dual imperative of اِئْتَنَسَ (iʔtanasa)
